metadata.ogTitle: Free AI for Business Training Programme | Tabi Academy
metadata.ogDescription: Build faster and work smarter. Our 2-week intensive AI cohort helps female entrepreneurs master automation and innovation. Sign up now!

timeline.heading: Here's Exactly What You're Signing Up For
timeline.description: No surprises, no guesswork. From your first day to graduation and beyond, here's every stage of the experience — so you know exactly what to expect and can show up fully ready.

onboarding.title: Pre-Programme Onboarding
onboarding.description: Get set up, get excited, and arrive ready. You'll receive your welcome pack, participant agreement, full schedule, tool setup guides, and direct access to your cohort community — all before the first session begins.

week1.title: Week 1 · Live Training
week1.description: Four full-day live sessions covering AI fundamentals, design tools, app building, and automation. Every session follows a learn → demo → build → share cycle. You'll leave each day with something tangible.

week2.title: Week 2 · Capstone & Certification
week2.description: Apply everything you've learned to a real business challenge. Build your capstone project, present live to the cohort, and sit your certification exam. This is where it all comes together.

postProgramme.title: Post-Programme · Alumni Community
postProgramme.description: Six months of access to all recordings and materials. Two weeks of dedicated post-programme support. And permanent membership in the Tabi Academy alumni community — a network that keeps giving.

curriculum.heading: Four Days That Change How You Work
curriculum.description: Each day is structured around a core AI capability — and each one builds on the last. By Day 4, you'll have gone from AI foundations to deploying autonomous agents for your business.

day1.title: AI Foundations & Business Strategy
day1.description: Understand what AI tools actually are, how they work, and where they create the most leverage in a business. Map your own biggest challenges to AI solutions. Leave with a strategic AI roadmap for your business.
day1.deliverable: AI opportunity map for your business

day2.title: Design, Branding & Visual Content
day2.description: Use AI design tools to create professional graphics, a complete brand kit, and UI wireframes or mockups. No design experience needed — just your vision.
day2.deliverable: Brand kit + UI mockup or wireframe

day3.title: Build & Publish with AI
day3.description: Build a fully functional landing page or simple application using AI-powered development tools. Publish it live. Walk away with a real URL.
day3.deliverable: Live published landing page or app

day4.title: Automation, AI Agents & Workflows
day4.description: Create an AI agent or automation workflow running a real task for your business. From lead capture to content scheduling — this is where AI works for you, not the other way around.
day4.deliverable: Deployed automation or AI agent workflow

certification.description: Certification isn't handed out. It's earned. To receive your verified AI for Business certificate, you need to show up, do the work, and demonstrate real capability.

attendance.title: 80% Attendance
attendance.detail: Across all 4 live Week 1 sessions — 3 out of 4 days minimum.

assignments.title: Daily Assignments
assignments.detail: Completed and submitted from Days 1–3. They feed directly into your capstone.

capstone.title: Capstone Project
capstone.detail: Full written report + 10-minute live presentation to the panel on Day 9.

exam.title: Certification Exam
exam.detail: 60 minutes, online, on Day 10. Auto-submits at the time limit.

score.title: Combined Score of 70%+
score.detail: Capstone weighted at 60%, exam at 40%. Both must be submitted to qualify.

certificate.subtitle: Certificate of Completion
certificate.description: For successfully completing the AI for Businesses intensive programme and demonstrating applied competency across all four training domains.
certificate.verification: Digitally verified · Issued within 5 business days

retake.title: One free retake included
retake.description: Didn't pass first time? You have 14 days to retake the exam at no extra cost. No pressure — just another shot.

faq.contactMessage: Can't find your answer here? Reach out directly — the team responds within one business day.

items.q: Do I need a technical background?
items.a: No. This programme is designed specifically for business owners and professionals — not developers. If you can use a smartphone and a laptop, you have everything you need to start.
ChatGPT, Canva, Uizard, GitHub, Zapier, and Vercel or Netlify — plus additional platforms introduced per session. Every tool has a free tier. No paid subscriptions are required.

items.q: How many people are in each cohort?
items.a: A maximum of 50 participants per cohort. This isn't a webinar — it's a live, interactive learning environment where the facilitators know your name and your business.

items.q: What if I miss a session?
items.a: Recordings are made available within 24 hours. Missing one session keeps you within the 80% attendance threshold. Missing two or more makes you ineligible for certification. Notify the team in advance if you need to miss a session.
Yes. All sessions are delivered live via Google Meet. You'll need a laptop or desktop, a stable internet connection, a working webcam, and a quiet environment.

items.q: What happens after the programme ends?
items.a: You get two weeks of dedicated post-programme support, six months of access to all recordings and materials, and permanent membership in the Tabi Academy alumni community.

Full refund for cancellations more than 14 days before the start date. 50% refund between 7–14 days. No refund within 7 days or after the programme has commenced. A one-time deferral to the next cohort is available if requested at least 5 days before the start date.

items.q: Can I defer to a future cohort?
items.a: Yes — once. If you notify the team at least 5 days before the programme start date, you can defer your place to the next available cohort.

faq.heading: Common Questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about the Tabi Women Network experience.

items.q: Who can attend Tabi Women Network events?
items.a: Attendance is strictly by personal invitation. Each edition is curated specifically for women in executive, senior, founder, or leadership roles across tech, business, and governance. If you have received an invitation, you belong in the room.

Women interested in attending a future edition or hosting one in their city can express interest via our city request form or by reaching out to sophia@tabiproject.com. Curation is intentional, so not every expression of interest will result in an invitation.

Each invitation admits one person only. To maintain the intimacy of the table, we do not allow +1s. However, if you believe another woman should be at the table, you are encouraged to mention her to the host. The team will consider extending a separate invitation.

items.q: Is there a cost to attend?
items.a: Attendance details, including any applicable costs for the curated dining experience, are communicated directly to guests upon confirmation of their invitation.

items.q: What is the policy on arrival time?
items.a: We are building a culture of respect for time. Each event starts exactly at the stated time. Guests are welcomed from 15 minutes before the start, and we ask that you arrive early to settle in before the roundtables begin.

items.q: How do I get Tabi Women Network in my city?
items.a: We are expanding monthly across Africa. If you want us to land in your city next, please use our 'Indicate Interest' form. We prioritize new locations based on where our community demand is strongest.
Every attendee is added to the Tabi Women Network member directory—a living resource designed to help members find collaborators and build real partnerships across borders and sectors.

The core programme and conversations at the table are never recorded to ensure authenticity and vulnerability. What is said at the table stays at the table. We do, however, have a media team available for optional seated interviews during the open networking segment.

items.q: How often does the network meet?
items.a: Editions are held monthly in different cities across Africa. Members are welcome to attend editions in their home city and may be invited to editions in other cities where they have a professional presence.

manifestoQuote.line1: The Tabi Women Network is where
manifestoQuote.quote: "We are building a decentralized ecosystem for African women leaders. No gatekeepers. No fluff. Just the technology, governance, and social capital needed to build global legacies."

mission.label: Mission
mission.heading: Championing Tech Empowerment
mission.body: At the Tabi Empowerment and Educational Foundation (TEEF), we are dedicated to bridging the gender gap in technology through exceptional tech education, pioneering research and development, and the promotion of open-source projects. Our mission is to empower African women with the skills and opportunities needed to thrive in the tech industry, fostering an inclusive and innovative ecosystem. Through our unwavering commitment, we aim to uplift individuals, transform communities, and inspire a future where women lead and excel in technology and innovation.

vision.label: Vision
vision.heading: Our Vision for Tomorrow
vision.body: At the Tabi Empowerment and Educational Foundation (TEEF), our vision is to create a world where African women are at the forefront of technological innovation, leading advancements and making significant contributions to the global tech landscape. We aspire to cultivate an environment where education and opportunity are accessible to all, fostering a diverse and inclusive tech community. By empowering individuals with the tools and knowledge to excel, we aim to drive sustainable development, inspire change, and shape a future where the potential of every woman is fully realized and celebrated.

cta.heading: Applications Are
cta.description: Only 25 developers will be accepted for Cohort 1. If you're serious about building products and earning from your skills — this is your room.
cta.footnote: Limited seats available · Cohort begins June 11

whyThisExists.heading: Why Most Developers
whyThisExists.description: Most developers never move from learning to earning — because they never learn how real products are actually built.
whyThisExists.problemCardTitle: The Pattern That Keeps You Stuck
problems: Tutorial after tutorial — nothing ever ships.
Ten frameworks learned, zero products built.
Technical skills with no clear income path.
No idea how real SaaS products are structured.
solutions: One real SaaS product, deployed in 4 weeks.
AI integration, payments, and a 90-day income roadmap.
25 serious developers, guided by live experts.
whyThisExists.bottomQuote: No noise. No hype. Just one stack, one product, one clear path to income.

boringStack.heading: Why We Use
boringStack.description: We skip the framework of the week. Every tool was chosen because it is stable, battle-tested, and actively used in real-world products today. Your skills won't expire in six months.

items.desc: Approachable, powerful, and used in production by thousands of SaaS companies worldwide.
MVC architecture for Node.js — built for real-world APIs and data-heavy applications.
Connects Vue to Sails with zero API boilerplate. Write server-side apps with the feel of a modern SPA.
Utility-first CSS that makes building polished, responsive UIs fast — without fighting your stylesheet.

boringStack.bottomStatDesc: Everything you need to build and ship a real SaaS — from database design and authentication to AI integration and payment processing.

curriculum.heading: From First Commit
curriculum.description: 4 weeks. 12 live sessions. 2 hours 30 mins each. One complete deployable SaaS product — no filler, no fluff.
curriculum.footerText: You build this. Live. Every session.

weeks.label: The Foundations
weeks.build: Your first full-stack app. Understand exactly how the pieces connect — and build something real by Friday of week one.

weeks.label: The Core Engine
weeks.build: Build a Project Tracker SaaS with auth, create-read-update-delete, cloud file handling, and a polished dashboard.

weeks.label: The AI Edge
weeks.build: Add a streaming AI chat assistant to your SaaS. Learn to prompt, integrate, and deploy AI-powered product features.

weeks.label: The Income Path
weeks.build: Capstone demo, payment integration, and your personal 90-day income roadmap — freelancing, micro-SaaS, or remote work.

outcomes.heading: By The End,
outcomes.description: Every outcome below is earned through the work you ship during the programme — not a participation trophy. No vague “skills.” Concrete deliverables.

items.title: A Deployable SaaS Product
items.desc: Not a tutorial clone. A complete, live product you built from scratch — that you own and can show to anyone.

items.title: AI-Powered Product Features
items.desc: LLM integration, streaming chat, and AI workflow automation baked into your product.

items.title: Payment Integration Experience
items.desc: Stripe configured and live inside your application — the final piece most developers never add.

items.title: A Portfolio Project That Stands Out
items.desc: A full-stack, AI-enabled, payment-ready SaaS — not another to-do app.

items.title: A 90-Day Income Roadmap
items.desc: A clear personal strategy — freelancing, micro-SaaS, or remote dev — built live during Week 4.

items.title: Certificate of Completion
items.desc: Awarded upon capstone presentation. Evidence of real, practical full-stack capability.

outcomes.closingDesc: Every graduate leaves with a live product, a certificate, and a 90-day income plan — not just a completion badge.

admission.heading: Not for Beginners.
admission.description: This bootcamp moves fast and assumes you can read code, follow logic, and troubleshoot independently. We protect the quality of this room.
admission.goldenRuleText: You must have written working code before — loops, functions, logic. The language doesn't matter. The mindset does.
qualifies: Built small scripts or projects, even if rough.
Completed a course that included actual coding exercises.
Self-taught from tutorials where you wrote real code.
Can explain what a variable, function, or loop does.
Prior language doesn't matter — Python, PHP, Java, JS, anything.
doesntQualify: You’ll benefit more if you’ve written some code before.
Watching tutorials alone may not be enough preparation yet.
Basic understanding of variables and functions is recommended.
This programme is not designed as a first introduction to programming.
admission.doesntQualifyFooter: If you're still early in your journey, we’ll recommend beginner-friendly resources to help you prepare for future cohorts.

metadata.title: Privacy Policy
metadata.description: Tabi Empowerment & Educational Foundation (TEE Foundation) Privacy Policy. Learn how we collect, use, and protect your personal data.

Privacy.label: Privacy Policy
Privacy.title: Tabi Empowerment & Educational Foundation (TEE Foundation)
Privacy.footerNote: This Privacy Policy was last reviewed and updated in January 2026.

content.text: Tabi Empowerment & Educational Foundation is a non-profit organisation registered in Nigeria, dedicated to empowering women through education, mentorship, and technology. We operate through three arms: TEE Foundation (governing body), Tabi Academy (education and training), and Tabi Project (community impact initiatives).
For the purposes of data protection, TEE Foundation is the data controller responsible for your personal information.

content.title: Information You Provide Directly
content.text: When you register for a programme, make a donation, or contact us, we may collect the following:
bullets: Full name and contact details (email address, phone number, location)
Payment information (processed securely through our third-party payment providers; we do not store full card details)
Educational background and professional information (for programme eligibility and matching)
Emergency contact information (where relevant to in-person programmes)
Communications and correspondence you send to us

content.title: Information Collected Automatically
content.text: When you visit our website, we may automatically collect:
bullets: Browser type, device type, and operating system
IP address and approximate geographic location
Pages visited, time spent on site, and referring URLs
Cookie data and analytics information (see Section 7 on Cookies)

content.text: We use the information we collect for the following purposes:

items: To process programme registrations and confirm enrolments
To process payments and issue receipts or invoices
To communicate important updates about your programme or registration
To send our Annual Impact Report to donors and contributors
To deliver and improve our educational content and community services
To send newsletters, event updates, or programme announcements (with your consent)
To comply with legal and regulatory obligations
To analyse and improve the performance of our platforms and programmes

content.text: We will not use your data for purposes incompatible with those listed above without your explicit consent.
We process your personal data on the following legal bases:

items: Contract performance — processing necessary to register you in a programme or process your payment.
Legitimate interests — improving our services, communicating impact, and ensuring the safety of our community.
Consent — for marketing communications and non-essential cookies. You may withdraw consent at any time.
Legal obligation — where we are required to process data to comply with Nigerian law or regulatory requirements.

content.text: Tabi does not sell, rent, or trade your personal data to third parties. We may share your information in the following limited circumstances:

items: Service providers: We work with trusted third-party providers (such as payment processors, email platforms, and website hosting services) who access your data solely to perform services on our behalf and are bound by confidentiality obligations.
Legal requirements: We may disclose your information where required by law, court order, or governmental authority.

Programme partners: Where a programme is delivered in partnership with another organisation, we may share relevant participant information with that partner, subject to appropriate data protection agreements.

content.text: All third parties are required to handle your data securely and in accordance with applicable data protection law.

All payment transactions on Tabi's platforms are processed by Paystack, a PCI-DSS compliant third-party payment provider. Tabi does not store, process, or have access to your full card details. By making a payment on our platform, you are subject to Paystack's Privacy Policy and Terms of Service in addition to ours.
Donation records and programme payment records are retained for a minimum of 7 years in line with financial and regulatory requirements.
Our website uses cookies to enhance your experience and gather analytics data. Cookies are small data files placed on your device. We use:

items: Essential cookies — necessary for the website to function properly.
Analytics cookies — to understand how visitors interact with our site (e.g., Google Analytics).
Preference cookies — to remember your settings and preferences.

content.text: You can manage or disable cookies through your browser settings. Please note that disabling certain cookies may affect the functionality of our website.
We retain your personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes for which it was collected, or as required by law. Specifically:

items: Programme registration data is retained for a minimum of 3 years after the completion of the programme.
Financial and donation records are retained for a minimum of 7 years.
Marketing contact data is retained until you unsubscribe or withdraw consent.

content.text: When data is no longer needed, it is securely deleted or anonymised.
You have the following rights with respect to your personal data:

items: Right of access — to request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
Right to rectification — to request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.
Right to erasure — to request deletion of your data, subject to our legal obligations.
Right to restrict processing — to request that we limit how we use your data.
Right to object — to object to our processing of your data for specific purposes.
Right to data portability — to receive your data in a structured, commonly used format.
Right to withdraw consent — where processing is based on consent, you may withdraw it at any time without affecting prior processing.

content.text: To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at hello@tabiproject.com. We will respond to all requests within 30 days.

Our services are primarily intended for adults aged 18 and over. Where we offer programmes to participants under 18, we require verifiable parental or guardian consent before collecting any personal data. We do not knowingly collect personal data from minors without appropriate consent.

We take the security of your personal data seriously and implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect it against unauthorised access, loss, or destruction. These include secure data storage, access controls, and use of reputable, secure third-party platforms.

Despite these measures, no method of internet transmission or electronic storage is 100% secure. We encourage you to use strong passwords and to notify us immediately if you suspect any unauthorised use of your account.

Our website may contain links to third-party websites or social media platforms. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of those sites and encourage you to review their privacy policies independently.

Tabi may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or legal requirements. The updated Policy will be published on our website with a revised effective date. We encourage you to review this Policy periodically. Where changes are material, we will notify you directly where possible.
If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or how we handle your data, please reach out to us:

Tabi is a non-profit organisation committed to creating sustainable pathways for women to access, learn, and excel in technology. We operate three interconnected arms:

items: TEE Foundation — the governing oversight body ensuring our mission remains impactful and accountable.
Tabi Academy — structured learning programmes, skills training, and mentorship pathways for women in tech.

content.text: As a not-for-profit organisation, all revenues, fees, and donations received by Tabi are directed entirely toward the delivery of our mission and impact programmes.

items: You are at least 18 years of age, or have parental/guardian consent if under 18.
The information you provide during registration is accurate and complete.
You will use our services in accordance with these Terms and applicable laws.

content.title: Paid Programmes
content.text: Tabi offers paid training programmes and courses ("Programmes") from time to time. The fees for each Programme are clearly stated at the time of registration. All fees are quoted in Nigerian Naira (NGN) for participants within Nigeria, and in US Dollars (USD) for international participants. The USD equivalent is indicative and based on prevailing exchange rates at the time of registration. Participation in a Programme is only confirmed upon receipt of full payment of the applicable fee. Tabi reserves the right to adjust Programme fees at any time. Any fee changes will be communicated clearly before registration opens for the affected Programme.

content.title: Not-for-Profit Use of Fees
content.text: Tabi is a registered non-profit organisation. All Programme fees, donations, and revenue received are used exclusively to fund our educational programmes, community impact initiatives, operational costs, and the delivery of our mission. No profits are distributed to any individual or private entity.

content.title: Annual Impact Report
content.text: In line with our commitment to transparency and accountability, all donors and financial contributors to Tabi will receive an Annual Impact Report at the close of each financial year. This report will detail how contributions were utilised across our programmes and impact initiatives during that period.

content.title: Eligible Refunds
content.text: Tabi is committed to delivering quality programmes. The following refund terms apply to all paid Programmes:
bullets: Cancellations made 14 or more days before the programme start date are eligible for a full refund, less any applicable transaction or processing fees.
Cancellations made between 7 and 13 days before the programme start date are eligible for a 50% refund of the programme fee paid.

Cancellations made fewer than 7 days before the programme start date are not eligible for a monetary refund. However, participants may request a credit transfer to a future Tabi programme of equivalent value.

content.title: Non-Refundable Circumstances
bullets: Fees are non-refundable once a programme has commenced, except in extraordinary circumstances at Tabi's sole discretion.
Administrative or transaction fees charged by payment processors are non-refundable in all cases.
Donations made to Tabi are non-refundable as they are immediately applied to impact work and operations.

content.title: Requesting a Refund
content.text: To request a refund, please contact us at hello@tabiproject.com with your full name, programme name, payment reference, and reason for cancellation. Refund requests are processed within 10 business days of approval.

content.title: Cancellation by Participant
content.text: Participants may cancel their enrolment in a Programme at any time by notifying Tabi in writing to hello@tabiproject.com. Refund eligibility is subject to the timelines outlined in Section 5 above.

content.title: Cancellation by Tabi
content.text: Tabi reserves the right to cancel, postpone, or reschedule any Programme due to insufficient enrolment, unforeseen circumstances, or events beyond our reasonable control. In the event of a cancellation initiated by Tabi, registered participants will be offered the option of a full refund or a transfer to a rescheduled or alternative Programme. Tabi will not be liable for any travel, accommodation, or other ancillary costs incurred by participants as a result of a cancellation.
Tabi gratefully accepts voluntary donations from individuals and organisations who wish to support our mission. By making a donation, you acknowledge that:

items: All donations are voluntary and non-refundable once processed.
Donations are used exclusively to fund Tabi's educational programmes, community impact projects, and operational activities in line with our not-for-profit mandate.
You will receive an Annual Impact Report detailing the use of funds at the end of each financial year.
Tabi does not guarantee any specific outcome or programme delivery in exchange for a donation.

Not engage in any fraudulent or deceptive activity on our platforms.
